import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        long[] data = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            data[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        long[] countMap = new long[1001];
        for (long v : data) {
            if (v <= 1000) {
                countMap[(int) v]++;
            }
        }
        long[] prefixCounts = new long[1002];
        for (int i = 1; i <= 1000; i++) {
            prefixCounts[i] = prefixCounts[i - 1] + countMap[i];
        }
        long maxFreqFound = 0;
        for (int i = t; i <= 1000; i++) {
            maxFreqFound = Math.max(maxFreqFound, prefixCounts[i] - prefixCounts[i - t]);
        }
        System.out.println(maxFreqFound);
        sc.close();
    }
}
